_doc: Ordered list of TS derivers executed by 9_others/build.sh derive. Runs after consolidate; order matters when a later deriver consumes an earlier one's output. Adding a deriver = append a JSON entry; build.sh remains untouched (fire-rule 6: data-driven, never hardcoded).

derivers.name: config-derive
derivers.description: Per-consumer JSON files (build-*.json + cloud-data-*.json archive) from _cloud-data-consolidated.json

derivers.name: mesh-snapshot
derivers.description: WireGuard mesh + wstunnel TCP/443 fallback snapshot consumed by bb-net_wireguard-mesh panel as PORTAL_DATA[mesh]

derivers.name: build-workflows
derivers.description: Runner-image registry (runners + probe + dispatch) extracted from 9_others/build.json. Replaces legacy cloud-data-runners.json. Consumed by 1_cicd/src/scripts/cloud-ship-* and tests via symlink 9_others/src/build-workflows.json -> ../../1_cloud-configs/dist/build-workflows.json

derivers.name: code-signatures
derivers.description: Per-file code signatures (exports/imports/symbols, no bodies) for the cloud repo → dist/code-signatures-cloud.json. Deterministic structure layer feeding the kg-graph code nodes/edges AND the Opus semantic GraphRAG pass (~244k tokens vs 5.6M full source).

derivers.name: watchdog
derivers.description: Fleet declaration my-konsole's monitor panel reads: machines with their ssh/console action strings and manageable daemons, the declared firewall ingress, and storage. Ran by hand until now, which is why dist/watchdog.json could drift from the consolidated SoT.

derivers.name: mcp-json
derivers.doc: Project-scoped MCP server registry -> dist/mcp.json, copied into every repo as .mcp.json. Replaces cloud's tracked symlink to /home/diego/.mcp.json, which dangled everywhere but one laptop.

derivers.name: repo-map
derivers.doc: ONE source of truth for local_dir -> github_repo: I_cloud/repos.json. Stamps cloud-cgc-pub-mcp build.json .runtime.octocode.repo_map (scoped to index_repos) and the ops_git-sync.yaml REPO_MAP that mirrors it. That DAG is the single writer of the octocode_repos volume; its hand-copied map went stale across the cloud-* rename (cloud:cloud cloned the symlink index repo, not cloud-infra; front-data was missing). Fails the build on an index_repos entry that is undeclared in the registry, or on one excluded from the shared volume (cloud-vault).
